name: daily-service-report
title: Daily service report
for_each: select id,name from locations order by name

sections.title: Service results
sections.sql: select d.service_date,d.service,d.imported,d.served,d.no_shows,d.removed,d.handovers from daily_performance d join locations l on l.name=d.location where l.id=$1 order by service_date desc,service
sections.note: Dates are UTC. Archived imports are identified separately.

sections.title: Wait and service durations
sections.sql: select d.service_date,d.service,d.imported,d.mean_wait_minutes,d.mean_service_minutes,d.over_target from daily_performance d join locations l on l.name=d.location where l.id=$1 order by service_date desc,service
sections.note: Means use observed call times and completed interactions. A blank duration is unknown.

sections.title: Desk follow-ups
sections.sql: select a.* from attention a join locations l on l.name=a.location where l.id=$1 order by minutes desc

name: visit-record
title: Service interaction record
for_each: select id,token from visits order by token

sections.title: Service history
sections.sql: select sequence,location,service,clerk,status from ticket_summary where visit_id=$1 order by sequence

sections.title: Interaction times (UTC)
sections.sql: select sequence,queued_at,called_at,ended_at from ticket_summary where visit_id=$1 order by sequence

sections.title: Recorded actions
sections.sql: select e.created_at,e.action,e.actor,e.note from audit_events e join interactions i on i.id=e.interaction_id where i.visit_id=$1 order by e.created_at
sections.note: Internal working record. Actor names are supplied by the operator, not authenticated identities.
